memory_candidates.content: When a quality gate rejects an artifact on a count threshold, decompose the count into genuine defects vs. false positives before reaching for a gate/exemption/threshold change. If fixing only the genuine defects drops the total below the threshold, the false positives never need to be exempted at all - the fix moves entirely to the input layer and the gate stays untouched. This 'threshold arithmetic' check is cheap and should precede any exemption-widening design work, especially where the module's own history records that widening attempts raised false-positive counts via substitution self-interference.
